build: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends gnat binutils && cp shared/page.html page.html && cp shared/index-url.txt index_url.txt && ld -r -b binary -o assets.o page.html index_url.txt og.png && ADALIB=$(ls -d /usr/lib/gcc/*/*/adalib | head -1) && mkdir -p /tmp/alib && for l in gnat gnarl; do ln -sf "$ADALIB/lib$l.a" "/tmp/alib/lib$l-12.a"; done && gnatmake -O2 app.adb -o app -largs assets.o -static -L/tmp/alib && strip app && ls -l app
